description: This file contains unit tests for data-related classes such as DataElement and LinkedDataElement, utilizing the Google Test framework. It tests data copying, size management, CRC calculations, searches, bit operations, buffer management, and linked element relationships.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element supporting copy, size, CRC, search, bit operations, and buffer management.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Represents a linked data element supporting buffer management and enclosure of other elements.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Parser class for DataElement, supporting size retrieval and byte skipping.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into DataElement or LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns or sets the size of a DataElement.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a data range.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number within DataElement data with specified endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a numerical value at a specified position in DataElement.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a numerical value from DataElement.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence within DataElement.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specified offset within DataElement.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns DataElement data to a byte boundary.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Marks a LinkedDataElement as enclosed within another.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Handles enclosure status of linked data elements.
